cases.name: Teresa Lynn Spaw Howell
cases.narrative: Howell was last seen alive on July 1, 1989, at approximately 2:30 a.m. in the City of Hampton outside of the Zodiac Club. Later that same day, at approximately 10:10 a.m., a construction crew discovered women’s clothing near their work site. Her body was found shortly afterwards in the nearby wood line.

cases.name: Amy Jo Russell
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "The youngest of three children, Amy Jo, loved her family and friends.  There was nothing she would not do to help anyone in need.  She was feisty with an outgoing personality and knew what she wanted and how to get it.  Her faith in God was unwavering.  Amy Jo’s favorite color was red, and she was a die-hard 49ers fan.  She will truly be missed by all who knew and loved her."

Her Go Fund Me said, "Amy had a free spirit, contagious laughter, and a kind heart. she will be missed greatly by anyone lucky enough to have been in her presence. She was so loving fun and energetic she will be deeply missed."
